subject: Finalize vendor payout routing and PO aliasing
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@novalinx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor payout routing and PO invoice alias request

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We've completed the onboarding packet and attached our bank form and W-9 for Novalinx. Please find: novalinx_vendor_onboarding.pdf and nova_bank_details_form.pdf attached.

Quick context: Novalinx will prefer ACH for regular payouts, with wire fallback for special cases. For invoicing, our accounting team would like invoices to include a PO prefix so our ERP picks them up automatically. Can Redwood create a PO alias mapping of "NOVA-" (dash included) so invoices with that prefix route directly to our payables team? If you need a different format we can adapt.

Also: please confirm the micro-deposit verification process and expected timeline (same-day/1-2 business days?), and whether you need an executed ACH authorization letter signed by our CFO. I've attached an unsigned ACH authorization template; happy to sign and return.

Attachments:
- novalinx_vendor_onboarding.pdf (PDF)
- nova_bank_details_form.pdf (PDF)
- Novalinx_W9.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Vendor Ops / Novalinx Inc.
S: (415) 555-1189
payments@novalinx.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@novalinx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor payout routing and PO invoice alias request

Samantha — thanks for the docs, much appreciated. I downloaded the vendor packet and bank form. A couple of quick clarifying items so we can finish onboarding this week: 

- Micro-deposit verification: we typically send two small micro-deposits (random cents) to the account. Once you confirm the two amounts we mark the account verified and move it to active. Expected timing: deposits hit within 24–48 hours. For faster onboarding we can perform a same-day ACH verification on our end for an additional admin step (let me know if you want to expedite).

- ACH authorization letter: yes, please send a signed copy. If you can sign ach_authorization_signed.pdf and reply it will be attached to the payee record.

- PO aliasing: creating a mapping for invoices that start with "NOVA-" is fine. I will ask FinOps to set up an auto-route so those invoices bypass manual tagging. Lauren, can you create the alias NOVA- in Coupa (or mark as mapping in our payables flow)?

- Account normalization: can you confirm account type (checking vs. savings) and the beneficiary exactly as it appears on the bank statement? Our bank test will match beneficiary name to avoid future rejections.

For transparency I've looped in Lauren (Finance) and Marissa (Customer Success) to finalize the PO mapping and schedule the initial micro-deposit. Once verified we'll schedule the first pay run and confirm remittance format (we send structured remit with PO reference by default).

Thanks — I'll follow up once Lauren confirms the alias creation.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Vendor payout routing and PO invoice alias request — onboarding steps

Lauren / Finance Ops — forwarded Novalinx packet. Jonas asked us to create a PO alias of "NOVA-" so invoices with that prefix route directly to their AP. Please complete these steps: 

1) Create payee record for Novalinx Inc. in the AP system and attach the following to the payee profile: nova_bank_details_form.pdf, Novalinx_W9.pdf, ach_authorization_signed.pdf (pending).
2) Add PO alias mapping: key = "NOVA-" (match at invoice start), action = auto-route to Novalinx pay-run queue.
3) Flag the payee for two micro-deposit tests. Once we receive vendor confirmation of amounts, mark account verified and move to active.
4) Ensure structured remittance includes PO reference and our internal payee id (PO-4837) in the remittance XML.

I've attached our internal onboarding checklist for follow-up: redwood_internal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Let me know if you need additional info from Samantha. Jonas — finance will confirm when alias and payee are live.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@novalinx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor payout routing and PO invoice alias request

Thanks — quick update from our side: 

- We received two micro-deposits this morning: $0.13 and $0.41. Confirmed. Mark the account as verified from your side and proceed.
- We've attached the executed ACH authorization letter: ach_authorization_signed.pdf (PDF).
- Novalinx will use ACH for regular disbursements. For the PO alias, NOVA- is confirmed; our invoices will begin with that prefix starting with the July cycle.

Please confirm once the payee is live and the next scheduled pay run is queued. Also confirm the remittance format (CSV vs structured XML) and whether you'll include our internal PO-4837 tag in the remittance.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — Samantha

Attachments:
- ach_authorization_signed.pdf (PDF)
